run_time_func_benchmark: run time_func to benchmark a callable function over 100 iterations with warmup
test_time_func_custom_iterations: test time_func with a custom number of iterations to measure performance
test_time_func_named: test time_func with a custom name label for the benchmark output
refactor_time_func: refactor time_func to return timing results instead of printing them
summarize_time_func: summarize the time_func utility that benchmarks callables with warmup and perf_counter
